attribution: Railway centrelines: Natural Earth 10m cultural vectors (public domain), which carry no names over India; each line is the course the source holds between the places listed in this folder. Names, dates and lengths checked against Indian Railways and Wikipedia.
_join: The source has geometry but no names, so an item lists the places its line is known by and the build walks the source's own parts between them.
_rank: 1 is a trunk line drawn widest, 3 a short one drawn finest; the engine reads rank, never a line's name.
